fursona.description:
Slag is an anthro iron golem with a broad-shouldered presence. He appearance features weathered iron plates with copper seams; his eyes are dark brown. He is easy to recognize by weathered iron plates with copper seams. He makes a small house at the edge of town feel lived-in with a few useful comforts and collected keepsakes.

Slag keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset. He works as museum exhibit fabricator, though the job is only one part of his life. He enjoys spending quiet hours with metalworking and silent films.

summary: Slag (Arthur Vale) is a man anthro iron golem, born 1964-01-31, with museum exhibit fabricator as his work situation. Patient and humble, he brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality: Slag is patient and humble. He tends to notice details and approach unfamiliar situations with curiosity and care. He appreciates clear communication and respects other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and has a wry sense of humor. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else and can reconsider a position when given a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Keeps a pocket notebook for names and small observations.
• Night routine: He plans errands and social visits around a late schedule, preferring quieter hours when possible.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience can help him spot a relevant detail, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: He welcomes respectful curiosity about his species and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Slag enjoys metalworking and silent films. He has familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend makes the introduction. He likes low-key company: sharing a meal after a shift, visiting a quiet corner of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Slag while most of the neighborhood is asleep and finds he in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about metalworking turns into an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An odd detail connected to his work needs a second pair of eyes.
• A small favor: He could use company or a helping hand with an unusual but manageable task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a keepsake, place, or old story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use he/him pronouns for Slag. His gender, appearance, and species are parts of a complete character, not a summary of his personality. He is an anthro iron golem; do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Slag's name, real name, birthday, history, work, and residence are fictional. The late sleep schedule is a routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable in daytime scenes. He can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop interests through roleplay.
